Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Tallinn hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 18 Tallinn hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 6, Billabook.com at 1, Bluepillow.co.uk at 1, Bob W Ambassador at 1, Evendo at 1 and the hotel's own site at 1. Taxes and fees at Tallinn hotels

At the 14 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 13% ($9 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 12% at Rixwell Collection Savoy Boutique Hotel to 16% at City Hotel Tallinn. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
